violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN WARMER BEHIND BAR: COOKED BOBA AT 125F (30MIN) OBSERVED ON SHELVING ACROSS FROM COOKLINE: TOM YUM SOUP AT 129F (30MIN)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BOBA AND TOM YUM TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED CUT CABBAGE AND CUT LETTUCE HELD ON TIME WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH END POINT.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: FOODS LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OBSERVED NO RAW ANIMAL FOOD ON BOTH ONLINE AND PAPER MENU OFFERED FOR HOT POT TO BE ASTERISKED. ALSO OBSERVED NO DISCLOSURE STATEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. ADD AN ASTERISK TO EACH RAW ANIMAL FOOD ITEM ON EACH VERSION OF THE MENU. ON THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU, PLEASE ADD THE FOLLOWING FULL STATEMENT: *This item may be served undercooked. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness. AS DISCUSSED, PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY AUGUST 10TH.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED FILTER CHEMICAL IN WORKING BOTTLES STORED ON TOP OF BOXES OF CANE SUGAR SYRUP IN STORAGE CLOSET BY SERVER STATION.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CHEMICALS MOVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE MEDICINE STORED ON TOP OF SOUP BASE IN STORAGE OFF OF BACK HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. CDI: EMPLOYEE MEDICINE MOVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed hand washing sink by the three vat sink did not have hot water working.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Personal in charge agreed to repair the broken handwashing sink, will follow up to verify compliance.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Handwashing sink on the cook line was temped at 87° during the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PSIC fix hot water in washing machine sink was observed at 100°.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. EHS observed a meat slicer that was not cleaned after use of slicing raw meats.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC had employee clean and sanitize meat slicer, agreed to retrain staff to clean meat slicer between different raw animal products.

violations.title: (2017) RTE TCS Food, Date Marking Based on Ingredients
violations.observation: The following ready-to-eat food that is made using a combination of ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety ingredients is not properly dated for discard using the date of the first-prepared ingredient: Bok choy , cut cabbage, sliced chicken, sliced pork belly, sliced beef, prepared squid, housemade kimchi.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that combined with additional ingredients, or portions of the same food, must retain the date marking of the earliest or first prepared ingredient. PIC made date labels for TCS foods.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: observed no disclosure statement on the menu stating items on the menu are served raw or undercooked.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC agreed to contact owners about updating menu with a revised consumer advisory statement. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: items served raw or under cooked on the bbq menu.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS asked PIC to contact owners about re-writing menus so they include an asterisk marking times as raw or undercooked. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: EHS observed no thermometer in the 2 door prep top cooler in the cold holding unit across from the wok line.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC agreed too replace the thermometer in the 2 door prep top across from the wok line

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHS osberved rice, sugar salt, flour, herbs and various ingredient in whit emus blanks and garbage bins designated for food storage being used without common name labels throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS asked PIC to make labels for the foods.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control devices were observed over the shelving in the rear of the kitchen next to the walk in coolers.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. PIC took the insect control devices down and replaced them away from food storage or active food prep surfaces.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: EHS observed ply wood being used in the walk in coolers and walk in freezer as shelving.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS asked PIC to dispose of plywood, pic agreed too dispose of the plywood shelving and acquire non porous or absorbent shelving ( metal or plastic)

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information pertaining to an 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY IN PLACE LISTING 5 MAJOR SYMPTOMS OF FOODBORNE ILLNESS OR THE TOP 6 FOODBORNE ILLNESSES.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED WRITTEN EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY PACKET. CFM WILL HAVE ALL FOOD EMPLOYEES REVIEW AND SIGN THE POLICY.
